risks.risk: The compressor may not fit or work with a Toyota Corolla 2006 due to model or year incompatibility.
risks.proof: A photo showing the compressor installed on or matched with a Toyota Corolla 2006, or a clear OEM part number matching the vehicle’s specifications.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or non-functional for the claimed vehicle

risks.risk: The compressor may be damaged internally (e.g., seized, leaking refrigerant, worn clutch) not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the compressor running with the clutch engaging, or a pressure test showing no leaks.

risks.risk: The compressor may be counterfeit or non-genuine DENSO, despite the label.
risks.proof: A close-up of the label with serial number and hologram (if any), or a photo of the part number cross-referenced with a genuine DENSO catalog.

proof_requests: Photo of the compressor’s part number and any OEM code, clearly readable.
Photo or video showing the compressor running and clutch engaging.
Photo of the compressor installed on a Toyota Corolla 2006, or a matching part number from the vehicle’s manual.
Close-up of the label with serial number and hologram (if any).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a DENSO AC compressor, but the seller’s claim of compatibility with Toyota Corolla 2006 cannot be verified from the current photo.
